title: Analytical modelling of compliance dynamics under fiscal feedback: tipping thresholds, intervention costs and hysteresis
abstract: arXiv:2611.29688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compliance with taxes and other collective obligations is often enforced with resources that come from those who comply, so that non-compliance erodes its own deterrent. We develop an exactly solvable dynamical model of compliance under this fiscal feedback. Individuals choose between paying and evading by imitating those who do better, and the budget against evasion is a share of the revenue, split between enforcement and education. The model yields closed-form expressions for the equilibria, the tipping thresholds and their bifurcations, the budgets needed to maintain compliance and to restore it after a collapse, and the recovery time near the threshold. Fiscal feedback alone does not produce tipping points: hysteresis appears only when an instrument that changes individual incentives, such as fines or education, is funded by the tax base. translated_title: 财政反馈下合规动力学的解析建模：临界阈值、干预成本与迟滞效应
translated_abstract: 遵守税收及其他集体义务的行为通常依靠资源来强制执行，而这些资源恰恰来自遵守者本身，因此不合规行为会侵蚀其自身的威慑力。我们在这种财政反馈下构建了一个可精确求解的合规动力学模型。个体通过模仿那些获益更多的人来在纳税与逃税之间做出选择，而用于打击逃税的预算则是收入的一部分，并在执法与教育之间进行分配。该模型给出了均衡态、临界阈值及其分岔、维持合规所需预算、合规崩溃后恢复所需预算以及阈值附近恢复时间的闭式表达式。研究发现，仅有财政反馈并不会产生临界点：只有当改变个体激励的工具（如罚款或教育）由税基资助时，才会出现迟滞效应。更强的处罚会同时降低维持预算与救援预算，但超过某个临界水平后……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了一个财政反馈下可精确求解的合规动力学模型，给出均衡、临界阈值与维持及恢复合规预算的闭式表达式，并揭示出只有当罚款或教育等激励工具由税基资助时，才会出现临界点与迟滞效应。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an exactly solvable dynamical model of compliance under fiscal feedback, providing closed-form expressions for equilibria, tipping thresholds and maintenance/rescue budgets, and showing that tipping points and hysteresis emerge only when incentive-changing instruments such as fines or education are funded by the tax base.
